'''Heinz Werner Engl''' (born 28 March 1953) is an Austrian mathematician who served as the [[Rector (academia)#Austria|rector]] of the [[University of Vienna]].

Engl was born in [[Linz]]. He studied at the [[Johannes Kepler University of Linz]], where he earned an engineering diploma in technical mathematics in 1975, a doctorate in 1977,<ref name=mathgenealogy>{{mathgenealogy}}</ref> and a [[habilitation]] in 1979. He worked at the University of Linz starting in 1976 as an assistant professor, was promoted and tenured in 1981, and became a full professor in 1988. His research in this period concerned [[inverse problem]]s in [[applied mathematics]], with students including [[Barbara Kaltenbacher]].<ref name=mathgenealogy/> He became vice-rector of the University of Vienna in 2007, and rector in 2011.

With Martin Hanke and Andreas Neubauer he is the author of the book ''Regularization of Inverse Problems'' (Mathematics and its Applications 375, Kluwer Academic Publishers, 1996).<ref>Review of ''Regularization of Inverse Problems'' by Ulrich Tautenhahn (1997), {{MR|1408680}},</ref>

Engl won the [[Theodor Körner Prize]] in 1978, the Wilhelm Exner Medal in 1998,<ref>[http://www.wilhelmexner.org/liste_001.html Exner Medal awardee list] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170801075919/http://www.wilhelmexner.org/liste_001.html |date=2017-08-01 }}, retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> and the [[International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics|ICIAM]] Pioneer Prize (jointly with [[Ingrid Daubechies]]) in 2007.<ref>[http://www.siam.org/news/news.php?id=1207 ICIAM Pioneer Prize], SIAM, 21 October 2007, retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> He became a corresponding member of the [[Austrian Academy of Sciences]] in 2000, and a full member in 2003. He became a fellow of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] in 2009,<ref>[http://fellows.siam.org/index.php?sort=year&value=2009 SIAM Fellows class of 2009], retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> an inaugural fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] in 2012,<ref>[http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |date=2018-08-25 }}, retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> and a member of [[Academia Europaea]] in 2013.<ref>[http://www.ae-info.org/ae/User/Engl_Heinz Academia Europaea member profile], retrieved 2015-02-21.</ref> He is also a member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]].<ref>[http://www.euro-acad.eu/members?filter=e&land=Austria Austrian members of the European Academy of Sciences and Arts], retrieved 2015-02-22.</ref> In 2012, [[Saarland University]] awarded him an honorary doctorate.

He was a member of the Rotary Club Linz Süd from 1994 to 2012 and has been a member of the Rotary Club Vienna ever since. 

Heinz Engl is married and, according to his own statement, grandfather of Eleon Engl-Misirlisoy, the New Year's baby 2020 of the US capital Washington D.C.<ref>[https://orf.at/stories/3149417/ ORF News: Red-white-red New Year's Baby in Washington D.C.], retrieved 2020-01-03.</ref>
